proof_scope: Tau model-facing child-agent request admission, bounded child DAG compilation, handle registry, and agent-actionable steering requests

claims.does_not_prove: Semantic quality of external provider answers, UI pane rendering, Herdr pane adoption, or a real paid-provider child session.
claims.proves: Tau admits model-facing child-agent requests through a bounded policy, assigns durable child handles idempotently, compiles requests into executable Tau child DAG specs, joins accepted receipt results, and emits child instruction/cancel requests as agent-actionable operator actions rather than human blockers.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Model-facing child-agent requests are validated, fan-out/depth bounded, byte-idempotently admitted, compiled into Tau child DAG specs, joined by receipt handles, and steerable through agent-actionable operator requests.

cases.name: child-agent-requests-compile-and-run-three-child-dags
argv: cd .. && mkdir -p local/agentic-evals && rm -rf local/agentic-evals/tau-child-agent-requests-work && uv run python scripts/agentic-eval-tau-child-agent-requests.py --out local/agentic-evals/tau-child-agent-requests-proof.json --work local/agentic-evals/tau-child-agent-requests-work
